points.label: Action and sequence
points.left: Jesus begins to show the disciples that Jerusalem, suffering, death, and rising lie ahead; Peter rebukes him and receives a rebuke.
points.right: Jesus names Jerusalem, delivery, condemnation, Gentiles, mockery, scourging, crucifixion, and the third day in a compact forward sequence.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
points.right: The saying is detailed about actors and actions while recording no response from the Twelve in this range.

payload.posture: Matthew first narrates resistance to the suffering announcement, then preserves a later prediction with a more detailed custody sequence.
payload.tension: The first scene foregrounds Peter’s resistance and discipleship speech; the road scene foregrounds actors, treatment, and third-day timing.
payload.title: First disclosure / road detail
